definitions.gloss: full speed; top speed; at maximum speed
definitions.explanation: The fastest possible speed one can move. Almost always used adverbially with で to mean 'at full speed.'

examples.japanese: {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で{走|はし}った。
{全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で{逃|に}げたが{追|お}いつかれた。
examples.english: I fled at top speed but was caught up to.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは{合図|あいず}とともに{全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で{校庭|こうてい}を{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: At the signal, the children sprinted across the schoolyard at full speed.

notes:
A compound of {全|ぜん} (all, full), {速|そく} (speed), and {力|りょく} (power). Almost always used with the particle で as {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で (at full speed). Primarily describes running, but can apply to vehicles, swimming, and other movement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で{走|はし}る: to run at full speed
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で{逃|に}げる: to flee at full speed
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で{駆|か}ける: to dash at full speed
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で{向|む}かう: to head somewhere at top speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全力|ぜんりょく}: full power, all one's might — broader, applies to effort in general, not just speed
- {最高速度|さいこうそくど}: maximum speed — technical, used for vehicles and specifications
- {猛|もう}ダッシュ: mad dash — colloquial, emphasizes a sudden burst of sprinting
